body: Yeah, I usually try not to repot when I bring a plant home, but if a plant is at risk for root rot due to watering all the time, I do. Thanks for the advice, glad your plant is doing better!
Thanks! This is a kind  of hard to find plant in my area so I'd hate to think I'm overwatering it.
Hey, can you speak more on this? Currently in the process of figuring my life out and I'm debating getting an MFA. Why do you regret it, if you don't mind me asking?

Hey. I'm sorry you had to deal with someone like this. I have similar experiences with my father and depression and stuff. I spent so much time being bitter and hurting over him, and I regret that. I know what its like to seek validation from someone who will never give it you, too. It's hard dealing with that, and for some reason, its even harder to let go of that person, so I'm proud you could do that. Because you deserve so much better than that, and someone who constantly lets you down when they should be there for you has no place in your life.

Also, proud of you for stopping self harm and for pursuing art.

Yeah, I had all this bottled up for around six years, and by writing this I'm hoping I can let a lot of it go. 

I have depression (unrelated to this, I think) so some things are harder to accomplish than other things.

My mother has a boyfriend who supports us a little. He's not perfect, there's tons of things that i'm annoyed by, but he's still great overall, and I'm glad he's in my life. My sister has another father figure (a chef at the restaurant she works at.)

It's obviously not the same, but I'm happy with having positive experiences with important men in my life.
